setupScript: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
runScript: source venv/bin/activate && docker compose up -d && python scripts/init_db.py && python kafka_setup/create_topics.py && (python -m consumers.storage_consumer & python -m processors.price_processor & python -m consumers.alert_consumer & python -m producers.mock_producer & trap 'kill $(jobs -p) 2>/dev/null' EXIT; streamlit run dashboard/app.py)
